# 🔀 Pull Request

## 🎯 Summary
Describe what changed and why.

## 🔗 Related issue
Closes #

## 🧩 Change type
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature or enhancement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Accessibility
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Maintenance / refactor

## 🛠️ Implementation details
Describe important files, design decisions, dependencies, and trade-offs.

## 📸 Screenshots
For visual changes, attach before/after screenshots captured from the actual running page. Write “Not applicable” for non-visual changes.

## 🧪 Validation performed
- [ ] npm ci (if relevant)
- [ ] npm run build
- [ ] python3 scripts/validate-repository.py
- [ ] Local browser review
- [ ] Mobile and desktop review
- [ ] Keyboard/accessibility review
- [ ] Security/privacy review, if relevant

Commands actually run and results:

## ⚠️ Known limitations
List untested areas, risks, or follow-up work.

## 📚 Documentation
- [ ] README/docs updated.
- [ ] Project structure updated if needed.
- [ ] Diagrams updated if architecture changed.
- [ ] Changelog/roadmap updated if appropriate.

## ✅ Final checklist
- [ ] No secrets or private data.
- [ ] No unrelated files.
- [ ] Existing assets preserved unless intentionally changed.
- [ ] No fabricated test claims.
